Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in its "Updated Understanding" section. After the WebSurfer correctly identified the location as San Luis Obispo (based on the search results showing "Downtown SLO" and "Visit SLO"), the Planner incorrectly updated its understanding to state: "The Bubblegum Alley in California (the one analogous to Gum Wall) is in Downtown Monterey." This contradicts the evidence provided by the WebSurfer in the same step and represents a hallucination or confusion between two different California cities (San Luis Obispo and Monterey). This error was then carried forward, causing the Planner to issue subsequent instructions searching for coordinates in "Monterey" before eventually correcting itself in Step 3, but the initial mistake at Step 2 was the root cause of the confusion.
